exposure: cervical polypectomy via vaginoscopy without speculum, cervical forceps and anesthesia
cohort: The study included 90 pregnant patients diagnosed with cervical polyps at Beijing Tiantan Hospital between April 2017 and April 2023.
finding: Cervical polypectomy via vaginoscopy was found to significantly decrease the likelihood of preterm delivery and premature rupture of membranes in pregnant women with symptomatic cervical polyps.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in the mode of delivery between the two groups.
